subject: Exec recap: Redwood Inference discovery — Greenfield Health
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Exec recap: Redwood Inference discovery — Greenfield Health

Hi Emily — thanks again for the time today. Quick executive-level recap and proposed next steps for Tom and your procurement team.

Summary of discussion:
- Business outcome: reduce triage time for patient support queries and automate clinical note summarization to free care-team capacity (target: 40% reduction in manual work).
- Key pain points: inconsistent summarization quality across doc types, latency spikes during peak hours, and lack of predictable unit economics for batch workloads.
- Redwood fit: unified hosted + dedicated deployment options (can start hosted, migrate to dedicated GPU pools), batching/kv caching to control cost, and enterprise controls for audit/logging.

Risks and open items we flagged:
1) Prod SLA expectations for peak daytime traffic — Greenfield expects <150ms 95th p90 for top-priority routes.
2) Data residency and audit log retention; you mentioned SOC2 & audited KMS requirements.
3) Procurement timeline — need to understand your legal and security review gates and target procurement date.

Ask / next steps:
- Tom (or Procurement): share your procurement timeline and any required security artifacts. We can provide SOC2 report, encryption controls, and a short procurement packet.
- Redwood (Aditya): propose a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones + proposed pilot scope (3-weeks pilot, 2 routes, ~50k tokens/day budget).
- Exec one-pager: Laura will prepare a short executive summary focused on business outcomes and risk mitigation.

Attachments: GreenfieldProcurement_TL.pdf (procurement timeline template).

If that aligns, suggest a 30-min alignment call next week with Tom and anyone from procurement. Thanks — looking forward to moving fast.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: GreenfieldProcurement_TL.pdf (1 page, procurement timeline template)

From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@greenfieldhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@greenfieldhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec recap: Redwood Inference discovery — Greenfield Health

Laura — thanks for the concise recap and for joining the call today. That lines up with our internal read. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SLA: the 150ms 95th p90 is aspirational for patient-facing routes; for internal batch summarization we can tolerate higher latency but need predictable throughput.
- Security: we will need SOC2 Type II, encryption at rest with our customer-managed KMS, and a data retention policy we can sign off on.
- Procurement timeline: target decision by the end of Q3 (late Sep). Security review scheduled for the week of Aug 9.

Tom will be our exec sponsor — looping him on this thread. Procurement has asked for a brief mutual action plan and an exec one-pager that calls out cost model and fallbacks. Could you also include any references for healthcare customers?

Appreciate it — happy to meet next week.

Thanks,
Emily Carter
Head of Customer Experience | Greenfield Health
emily.carter@greenfieldhealth.com | (212) 555-0199

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec recap: Redwood Inference discovery — Greenfield Health

Laura / Marissa — good call. I drafted a proposed MAP and pilot scope attached — this includes milestones we can commit to (pilot onboarding, performance verification, SOC2 artifact handoff, procurement touchpoints).

Highlights from the MAP (attached MAP-GreenfieldHealth-v1.xlsx):
- Pilot scope: 3 weeks, two routes (patient-message triage + note summarization), 50k tokens/day with autoscaling to handle bursts.
- Acceptance criteria: 1) summarization quality above 0.85 on your eval set, 2) stable 95th p90 below 250ms for pilot routes, 3) audit logs and KMS integration validated.
- Procurement deliverables: exec one-pager, SOC2 report, encryption/KMS summary, standard SOW + commercial terms.

I'll take lead on the MAP and SOC2 artifact bundle. Laura — I'll need the Greenfield eval sample and a list of routes to include in the pilot. Emily / Tom — when you have a minute, can you share the security questionnaire contact and timeline?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

Attachment: MAP-GreenfieldHealth-v1.xlsx (Excel, 3 tabs: timeline, acceptance_criteria, contacts)

- Business impact: potential anchor customer in East Coast healthcare with a clear use case to reduce care-team hours.
- Timeline: procurement target EoQ3; security review early Aug.
- Risk: they expect strong SLA commitments; we'll likely need to propose Redwood Dedicated for long-term guarantees.

Request: can we approve a small commercial concession for the pilot (credits + reduced pilot rate) to accelerate contracting? Also requesting support from the enterprise team for an exec one-pager and any healthcare references we can share.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick sync.

Best,
Laura

Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Exec recap: Redwood Inference discovery — Greenfield Health

Thanks Laura — appreciate the clear exec summary. I agree this is a strategic healthcare prospect and we should prioritize a low-friction pilot path. Guidance: 

1) Commercial concession: approved a modest pilot credit and a reduced pilot rate contingent on a defined pilot SOW and acceptance criteria (Aditya to own SOW).
2) SLA posture: start with hosted pilot but include an addendum that allows a move to Redwood Dedicated with a transitional SLA. Work with Product/Reliability to validate if we can meet the 150ms 95th target for those specific routes.
3) Materials: Laura, please draft the exec one-pager focused on business outcomes, ROI estimate, and risk mitigations. I will loop in Solutions Engineering and Legal if the MAP looks good.

Next steps:
- Aditya: finalize MAP + pilot SOW and share with Greenfield by Mon Jul 26.
- Laura: exec one-pager due Fri Jul 24 (attach to the MAP).
- Marissa: I will prepare a short list of healthcare references we can share (2 customers) and pull legal for procurement templates.

Attaching an initial exec summary template — use this as a starting point and tailor the ROI metrics for Greenfield.

Best,
Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial | Redwood Inference
